t: Even for traditional participating products, determination of both bonuses to be paid along with  premium to be charged is:-
e: Correct answer: subject of pricing (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Assets invested for backing reserves earn less than what is required by the shareholders, for example, if assets are earning 9% per annum and risk discount rate is 12% per annum then:-
o: there is no cost of holding reserve for shareholde
there is optional cost of holding reserve for shar
there is a cost of holding reserve for customers
there is a cost of holding reserve for shareholder
e: Correct answer: there is a cost of holding reserve for shareholder (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Benefit payment on death only during a specified policy term. What type of policy is this?
e: Correct answer: Term plan (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Assuming single premium of 50,000 for a 25 years term insurance policy which has duration of 20 years. The discount rate has been assumed as 10%. If discount rate assumption would have been 11%, what would have been the approximate premium?
e: Correct answer: Approximately 41,500 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: As per Indian regulations, maximum allowable commission in first year is ________________ than the second year for a 20 years regular premium policy.
e: Correct answer: Higher (from the IC92 question bank).

t: What kind of insurance products are suitable for children?
e: Correct answer: Deferred Assurances (from the IC92 question bank).

t: One of the main issues associated with product design is _______________________.
o: proper communication to a lay customer
no communication to a smart company
poor communication to a lay company
proper communication to a lay company
e: Correct answer: proper communication to a lay customer (from the IC92 question bank).

t: If in a life table, number of survivors at age 32 are 75,670 and number of survivors at age 33 are 74,900, determine the mortality probability at age 32.
e: Correct answer: 1.02% (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Benefit payment on death only, and the amount of death benefit gets increased in a specified order according to year of death. What type of policy is this.
e: Correct answer: Increasing Term Assurance (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Akshay is a relatively cautious person. In insurance terms, this will normally increase the likelihood that he will:-
o: Be considered an above average insurance risk.
Be considered a below average insurance risk.
e: Correct answer: Require insurance cover. (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Who among the following will be having highest pure premium for a 10 lakh sum assured 10 years term insurance plan?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: 40 year old smoker male (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Indian regulations prescribes a minimum Required Solvency Margin as _______________.
o: Minimum Required Solvency Margin is not prescribed
e: Correct answer: Rs. 50 crores (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Commutation functions are generally  used under which method?
e: Correct answer: Formula method (from the IC92 question bank).

t: What normally happens to the sum insured under a life insurance policy once the period of the lien expires?
o: It is replaced by a newly underwritten sum insured
e: Correct answer: It increases. (from the IC92 question bank).

t: In unit linked products, mortality risk is always with:-
e: Correct answer: Insurance company (from the IC92 question bank).

t: profit margin of base scenario must meet ____________ profit requirement.
e: Correct answer: Minimum (from the IC92 question bank).

t: A life table is prepared by using the following past data:-
o: Number of births during different years in the
e: Correct answer: Mortality rate at different ages (from the IC92 question bank).

t: For regular premium policies, the law prescribes that first year commission can be higher for:-
o: Companies with more than 15 years of existance
Companies with more than 10 years of existance
Companies with less than 15 years of existance
Companies with less than 10 years of existance
e: Correct answer: Companies with less than 10 years of existance (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Mr. Samit buys an Endowment Assurance contract with profits for a Sum assured of 500,000 and a policy term of 15 years. He dies in the 7<SUP>th</SUP> policy year (i.e. after payment of 7 annual premiums). Total vested bonus for 7 years is 43,000. What is the benefit payable on his death?
e: Correct answer: Rs 543000 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: In case of a 'single premium' 10 years 'term insurance' policy, the policyholder dies in first year, what will happen?
o: The nominee will get the sum assured along with re
The nominee will get the sum assured
The nominee will get the sum assured along with th
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: The nominee will get the sum assured (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Lapse rate should be _________ when surrender profit is high.
e: Correct answer: Low (from the IC92 question bank).

t: While estimating the premium, investment returns is:-
o: Actual yield on 10 year Government bond
Equal to equity returns over last 10 years
A weighted average of equity and bond yields
e: Correct answer: An Assumption (from the IC92 question bank).

t: What is the process of checking the premiums to see if its affordable and satisfies the internal profit criteria?
e: Correct answer: Profit testing (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Marketability is greatly enhanced ___________.
e: Correct answer: All (a), (b) & (c) (from the IC92 question bank).

t: In case of initial fixed expenses, if policies are issued with small premiums:-
o: such policies would not be entertained
e: Correct answer: such policies would cause loss (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Calculate the amount invested in unit fund if premium paid is Rs. 1,000 and allocation rate is 90%.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: 900 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Insurance companies use mortality tables to:-
o: Determine whether a person is insurable
Predict how long a particular person will live
Tell the rate at which insured people are expected
Determine how much insurance a person may purchase
e: Correct answer: Predict how long a particular person will live (from the IC92 question bank).

t: What kind of assistance life insurance provides to the insured and to the dependants of the insured in the event of his death?
e: Correct answer: financial (from the IC92 question bank).

t: The minimum policy term is:-
o: For individual products, shall be at least one yea
For individual products, shall be at least two yea
For individual products, shall be at least five years
For individual products, shall be at least four ye
For individual products, shall be at least six yea
e: Correct answer: For individual products, shall be at least five years (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Investment freedom is there in:-
e: Correct answer: Unit-linked plan (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Measure of the number of deaths in a population is called:-
e: Correct answer: Mortality rates (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Product design should balance interests of:-
e: Correct answer: Policyholders and  shareholders (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Diversification is one way in which insurance companies can protect themselves against:-
e: Correct answer: Positively correlated risks (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Pure premium' is defined as:-
o: Cost of the benefits and initial expenses
Cost of the benefits and profit margin
Cost of the benefits and all the expenses
Cost of the benefits and commission
e: Correct answer: Cost of the benefits (from the IC92 question bank).

t: An Insurance Ombudsman can entertain a complaint where the value of the claim, including expenses, does not exceed:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). The limit was raised to ₹50 lakh by the amended Insurance Ombudsman Rules.

t: The whole life or term insurance doesn't meet all the needs of the policyholder as these policies do not provide ________ benefits.
e: Correct answer: survival (from the IC92 question bank).

t: If sum of the expected benefit pay-outs is 850,000 and sum of the present value of all the expenses is 150,000, which of the following would be the approximate amount of sum of the present value of annual premiums?
e: Correct answer: Much less than Rs. 1,000,000 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Reserves are required to be kept as __________ to ensure that company is able to meet the claims as it arises
e: Correct answer: liability (from the IC92 question bank).

t: If Fund Management charge (FMC) is 1% p.a. payable annually; Fund before FMC is Rs.100/- and Fund after this charge is:-
e: Correct answer: Rs.99 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Utility expected is referred to as ______________  in terms of money.
e: Correct answer: economic value (from the IC92 question bank).

t: If the life assured dies during the tenure of the insurance contract:-
o: the sum assured is not payable
the sum insured is invested in government bonds
the sum insured is spend wisely
e: Correct answer: the sum assured is payable (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Premium Allocation Charge is a percentage of the premium appropriated towards charges from:-
e: Correct answer: premium received (from the IC92 question bank).

t: To which year does the history of insurance date back?
e: Correct answer: 6000 (from the IC92 question bank).

t: The IRDAI portal through which a policyholder can escalate an unresolved grievance against an insurer is:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Bima Bharosa (formerly IGMS) is the grievance portal; Bima Sugam is the marketplace, Bima Vahak the women-led distribution channel and Bima Vistaar the combined rural product.

t: Lock-in-period means the period of ________ consecutive years from the date of commencement of the  policy.
e: Correct answer: five (from the IC92 question bank).

t: In insurance terms, the risk of suffering a disability is best described as what type of risk?
e: Correct answer: Financial. (from the IC92 question bank).

t: Group insurance generally costs _________ individual insurance.
e: Correct answer: less than (from the IC92 question bank).

t: If discount rate assumption is higher, premium will:-
e: Correct answer: Decrease (from the IC92 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Depends on lot of factors (from the IC92 question bank).

t: How much usually is the Stamp duty?
o: Re. 0.10 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof
Re. 0.50 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof
Re. 0.30 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof
Re. 0.75 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof
Re. 0.20 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof
e: Correct answer: Re. 0.20 every 1000 sum assured or part thereof (from the IC92 question bank).
